_comment: IAM Policy for the GitHub Actions CI/CD backend deploy role (attached to the GITHUB OIDC role, NOT to the EC2 instance profile).

_permissions_rationale.s3:PutObject: Upload the backend release tarball and deploy-backend.sh to the private S3 artifacts prefix.
_permissions_rationale.s3:GetBucketLocation: Required by some AWS CLI versions before multipart upload.
_permissions_rationale.ssm:SendCommand: Execute the deploy-backend.sh script on the EC2 instance without requiring SSH.
_permissions_rationale.ssm:GetCommandInvocation: Poll SSM command status so the CD job can wait for completion and detect failures.
_permissions_rationale.ec2:DescribeInstances: Resolve instance IDs when using instance name tags (optional convenience).
_permissions_rationale.NOTE — s3:GetObject NOT here: s3:GetObject on the artifacts prefix belongs on the EC2 INSTANCE PROFILE (see ec2-instance-profile.json), NOT on this GitHub role. The GitHub role only uploads; the EC2 instance downloads.
